summary: This is an independent read-only review of b2ccc748, the delta since f2596db6. Both former blockers are closed. (1) `consumer-runtime.ts` no longer reads `STYNX_TEST_PG_APP_PASSWORD`. It authenticates with the CI admin login (`STYNX_TEST_PG_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD`) and sends `options: '-c role=stynx_app'` at connection startup, and `connectionString` forwards `options` to the Database pool. It then asserts `current_user === 'stynx_app'` and `session_user === adminCfg.user` twice: on the direct SQL client, and inside `Database.tx(..., { role: 'app', requireActor: true })` on the Nest app pool. Because the role is set at startup, `superuser()` evaluates against `stynx_app`, so FORCE RLS really applies. The Architect amended the contract (4ad7ebe5) to permit exactly this. In `/private/tmp/stynx-ctg8-root-test-int.log`, the root `pnpm test:int` Turbo lane shows 52/52 tasks successful, `@stynx-nyx/cli:test:int: cache bypass, force executing` at line 522, and the packed consumer PASS at line 528. (2) The new rename-failure sensor uses a real OS failure. A 1024-character `--out` component makes `existsSync` and `lstatSync` return false, so preflight passes. `mkdtempSync` then creates `.stynx-generate-*` in the parent and every staged file is written before `renameSync` fails with ENAMETOOLONG. The catch block runs `rmSync(stage)`. The test asserts the rename error, that `--out` is absent, that no `.stynx-generate-*` entry remains, and that the parent holds only `blueprint.json`. Role separation holds: d795db3e (Inspector) touches only tests and the harness, 260ff032 (Architect) touches only `law/trace.json`, and bb6c5c19 (Engineer) touches only `packages/cli/src/generate-module.ts`. I re-ran the unit suite myself: CLI 83/83 passes, including the 47 generate-module tests. I also ran `pnpm check:trace`: 449/449 bound. The new tests do real work. Judging from the pre-fix source, each would have failed before bb6c5c19. The int32 default (2147483648 / -2147483649) was previously accepted by `isSafeInteger`. The `validateBody` guard is extracted from the generated controller with the TypeScript AST, run in a VM, and tested at both int32 edges and one past each edge. The root `/`+`/` route previously emitted `//:id`. A unique `tenant_id` index is now rejected. The literal `/example-records/x` route shadowed by `/:id` is detected with a segment wildcard compare. An ancestor symlink resolving outside its directory is now allowed, while the existing escaping-parent test still passes. The inert-metadata test now compares the full file set and every non-manifest file byte-for-byte with the digest header stripped. Packed-binary probes now cover the remaining gaps from cycle 1: refusing an existing `--out` with bytes unchanged, `--check` drift failing on a modified `src/crud_probe.module.ts` without writing, a restored `--check` passing, manifest path/order and SHA-256 recomputed for both outputs, and consumer overrides re-read and compared per tarball. The missing-tenant and missing-actor probes now require exact `TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING`/`ACTOR_CONTEXT_MISSING` codes and messages. DEVAI strict (`/private/tmp/stynx-ctg8-postrepair-devai.log`) reports `ok:true` and `findings:[]`, with the only applied receipt being `FORBID-DROP-PROD@0018f245e6137464f3388d0862e369ba894e1c99`, the same exact ephemeral-DB cleanup receipt. RLS smoke passed. I did not open separate logs for RLS negative, lint:tests or README; those rest on the checkpoint record. UPS-CLI-01 meets its MUST bar under OD-S15-01. Under OD-S15-02, CTG8 may now be imported last, after CTG7, into the cumulative branch. Full local CI, reference apps, the single final PR, remote CI and publication stay deferred to the completed-campaign gate. The remaining findings are nonblocking.
